name: Roast Curve
tagline: Roast green coffee at home, batch by batch
about: Roast Curve plans roast profiles for your roaster and beans, analyses your roast logs by first-crack timing, judges roast colour from a photo, and schedules resting so you brew at peak.
persona: You are a small-batch roaster who teaches: you speak in charge temperature, development-time ratio and first crack, and you treat smoke and chaff as real hazards.

onboarding.title: Your roaster, your beans, a plan
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us the machine and batch size so the times make sense.
bullets: Profiles for popper, air or drum roaster

tools.title: Plan a roast profile
tools.subtitle: Beans → target curve
tools.prompt: Plan a roast of {beans} to {target} for the profile's roaster and batch size. kv (charge temp or fan/heat setting, expected first-crack time, drop time, development-time ratio %, weight loss %), a table (Phase | Time window | Temp or setting | What to watch), steps for the roast including cooling, and a callout on the most common failure mode for this bean-roaster combination.

tools.title: Analyse my roast log
tools.subtitle: Paste times and temps

inputs.label: Roast log
inputs.placeholder: charge 200°C, turning point 1:10 @ 95°C, yellow 4:00, FC 8:30 @ 196°C, drop 10:15 @ 212°C, 14% loss

tools.prompt: Analyse: {log}. kv (DTR %, rate-of-rise trend, total time, verdict), bullets on what the numbers suggest about flavour (baked, scorched, underdeveloped, good), a table (Metric | Yours | Target for the profile's preference | Adjust by), and steps for the next roast changing one variable.

tools.title: Judge the roast
tools.subtitle: Photo of beans → level and defects

inputs.label: Photo of roasted beans on white paper

tools.prompt: Judge the roasted beans in the photo. Give kv (roast level, Agtron range est., evenness, surface oil, defects seen such as tipping, scorching or quakers), a table (Observation | Cause | Fix next time), and bullets on how this level will brew best.

tools.title: Buy green beans
tools.subtitle: What to order next

inputs.label: Wanting
inputs.placeholder: something chocolatey for espresso, plus one washed Kenyan

tools.prompt: Recommend green beans within a budget of {budget} (user's local currency) with wish: {want}, for the profile's roaster and taste. 4 cards (origin · process · variety, meta = price tier · roast difficulty), bullets on reading a green-coffee listing (density, moisture, screen size, crop year), and a callout on storing greens.

tools.title: Rest & brew schedule
tools.subtitle: When each batch peaks

inputs.label: Batches roasted
inputs.placeholder: Mon: 150 g Guji light; Wed: 200 g Brazil medium-dark

tools.prompt: For {batches}, build a table (Batch | Roast level | Rest days before brewing | Peak window | Best brew method). Then steps for degassing and storage, and a callout on why fresh-off-the-roaster espresso tastes wrong.

disclaimer: Roasting makes smoke, hot chaff and carbon monoxide. Roast with strong ventilation, never leave a roaster unattended, keep chaff away from heat, and keep an extinguisher nearby.
